evidence_class: Technical review of installed V2 physical surfaces
review_scope: Installed physical composition and its existing close-up camera set.

images.observation: Case, gauge and spent-metal feed pipe remain legible in the basement view.
Shelf and glass framing, floor grain and the hall threshold read around the chair.
The tile courses continue cleanly around the corner behind the cistern.
The fixed view shows dark brick and leaves the mechanism out of frame.
Timber floor, central fixture, door faces and table retain their materials under the pendant.
The lamp distinguishes the curtain weave, tile joints and porcelain.
Radiator, window shade, timber surfaces and furnishings remain visible around the resident.
The shelf, central window, moulding and floorboards remain distinct in the warm room.
The lamp shows the wall finish, counter edge and red-brown floor grain.
The open cabinet exposes the fuse faces, internal plates and conduit.
The bar trim and tile remain visible. The animal alcove is mostly in shadow.
The cat silhouette, shelf and framed print remain visible in the dim corner.
Paint chips and the beam edge remain legible above the back shelving.
Mail slots and seams read in the fixed view above the shadowed bench.
The lamp shade occludes the center. Several cast sections and the yellow valve remain visible.
The guardrails, drive surround, door and light fixture read from the upper landing.
Tank, hoops, supporting frame and parapet remain distinct against the skyline.
Green illumination picks out the terminal case next to the paper board and floorboards.
The joints and surface variation remain visible around the cistern and tiled return.
Color variation and the extent of the residue show on the timber under the lamp.
The exposed strands and their contact with the boards remain visible beneath the shade.
Crumbs, speckled counter and toaster casing remain distinct in the kitchen light.
The black frame, brass detail and station label read against the stippled plaster.
